name: Rainbow Six Siege (FPS)
description: Frees the CPU for Siege: the game is pinned to performance cores with High priority and the high-performance GPU, the global timer is held at 0.5 ms for the session, and background browsers drop to Idle so a Discord call or stream tab cannot steal frames mid-round.
notes: Voice chat is untouched: Discord and Ubisoft Connect are not listed, so calls and the game overlay keep working.
Nothing is suspended, only deprioritised; tabs, downloads and music resume instantly when the round ends.
If you run the Vulkan build, duplicate this file and change the trigger exe to RainbowSix_Vulkan.exe.
On a CPU without efficiency cores the affinity plan falls back to every logical processor; the rest still applies.
Thermal guard: above 90°C CPU or 87°C GPU the profile releases the game and waits 3 minutes before re-applying, so tuning never stacks on top of thermal throttling.
GPU temperature needs nvidia-smi; on other GPUs that half of the guard is reported as unenforced rather than assumed safe.
Biggest FPS wins are still in-game: Vulkan API, resolution scale at 100, and shadows/Lumen-equivalent effects down.
Network tuning follows only the server interface discovered at match time and is restored on exit; UDP-only traffic has no TCP stack value to tune.
